title: Initial release of Alchemia - a merge style game
author: DivineMage1
selftext:
I have somewhat of an interesting pipeline for my dev work.

I built out an AIQueue service so my clients (Claude + Codex) can make calls into it to offload some of their work / save tokens - specifically I use this for most of my art, some of my text needs, a little coding.

The local service has two pieces: it can use playwright to call out to free services + it can make calls to any local models I have setup.

On top of that since it's primary use is for images - I have built a variety of image tools into the queue, so not only will it generate an image from a free web service it will then process the image into whatever I need (including converting it to a 3d model, this is handled with a local llm)

Then to make sure it's used every projects [agents.md](http://agents.md) files all are setup to reference the AIQueue's API whenever possible.

Seems to work pretty well overall. Hope it inspires someone to give something similar a try!
